items.source: Base superclass for compiled expressions. Each generated compiled expression class will extend this class and implement the getValue(Object, EvaluationContext) method. It is not intended to be subclassed by user code.
items.translation: 编译表达式的基类。每个生成的编译表达式类都将扩展此类并实现 getValue(Object, EvaluationContext) 方法。它不打算由用户代码进行子类化。

items.source:
Subclasses of CompiledExpression generated by SpelCompiler will provide an
implementation of this method.
items.translation: 由 SpelCompiler 生成的 CompiledExpression 子类将提供此方法的实现。
